<!-- pr-reviewer: 8d40e96e93e1375254be46232cb2a98f802edfbc -->

**Verdict: merge-ready.** Built and tested locally on a merged tree (head 8d40e96e9 + main 110aca435; the trial merge is clean).

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1103 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. The new `setup_user_machines` pins pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets`: clean. The one warning is `camcraft-app`'s known lint on main (#2479), not from this PR.

Law checks: the file pick routes through the existing undoable `UseCatalogueMachine` command - no direct field write, no new command (#2358 stays a page change). The catalogue is shared with the Machines pane, so one enumeration serves both lists. A refused file is listed with its first refusal and cannot be picked: the refusal is visible, never silent (Prime Directive). The test shell pins `user_dir` to a temp folder, so no UI test reads the tester's folder. The decision record `docs/decisions/2358-setup-user-machines.md` is complete, the Gate map line is present, and no snapshot PNG changed. The body carries the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2358`.

Notes, not blockers:
- Opening the combo drops the cached list and re-reads the folder each time. That is a disk scan per open. It is small (a folder of `.mch` files); fine as is.
- The list shows "Load other" mounts as file entries by their file name. Good; it keeps a mounted custom machine from passing for a shipped one.

This is a `feat`: it merges at the next cut.
